_readme: CLEAR-BUG REGISTRY. A bug the owner reported, or one confirmed from stored evidence, goes here the moment it is confirmed - and the pre-push gate (scripts/admin/check-open-bugs.js) BLOCKS every push while any entry is open. That is the point: a reported bug is fixed immediately, not backlogged. Only CLEAR bugs belong here (reproduced, or owner-reported with evidence); design questions and improvements go to the task list instead. Close an entry by setting status to 'fixed' with the commit hash IN THE SAME COMMIT as the fix. Emergency escape: PUSH_WITH_OPEN_BUGS=1 git push (documented, visible, deliberate).

bugs.title: Animal in cast counts as a missing person -> false undercount -> Gemini fallback
bugs.note: vb.animals removed from buildSecondaryCharacterDescriptions; animals stay in the object pass. nonHumanNames plumbing kept as belt-and-braces.

bugs.title: Gemini second opinion discards ALL of DINO's boxes/masks/seeds instead of adding only the missing box
bugs.source: owner instruction + Lab exp #7 (p6/p8: every figure seeds=0)
bugs.note: merge arbitration: DINO keeps everything; only uncovered Gemini boxes appended, dressed + SAM-masked; backend 'dino+gemini-extra'.

bugs.title: Unpinned Lab bbox run loads scene v0 although image_version_meta says activeVersion=2
bugs.source: Lab exps #9 (unpinned -> v0 content) vs #10 (pinned v2 -> byte-exact match with production)
bugs.note: load is now observable: ask/got logged, v0 fallback WARNs, payload carries loadedFrom. Root cause still to be caught in the act — instrumentation makes the next occurrence data.

bugs.title: POST /api/admin/testlab/experiments drops target._params, so per-target version pinning silently does nothing
bugs.note: route passes _params through; target-level versionIndex reaches params.versionIndex.

bugs.title: Figures with correct SoM names still get zero garment seeds (empty descByPerson)
bugs.source: Lab exp #7 p7: production seeded 1/4, Lab 0/4, seedTrace empty
bugs.note: descByPerson falls back description->clothing->gdinoPrompt; empty line for a named figure = ERROR + failure_log, never silent.

bugs.title: Recolour version carried a stale, fp-nulled detection with no marker
bugs.source: job_1787120984020_pg71z58ba9 p7: v1 detection identical to v0's; runGarmentRecolour returned stale detection by design
bugs.note: OWNER DESIGN 2026-08-19: a recolour cannot move geometry, so carrying the parent boxes/masks is CORRECT and a fresh DINO+SAM is waste. The bug was the silent, fp-nulled carry. Fix: explicit carry — shallow copy, masks re-attached, sourceImageFp re-stamped to the NEW bytes (imageFingerprint), diag.recolourCarried marker. Only the EVAL re-runs.

bugs.title: Detection cache hashed URL strings as text — same bytes never shared an entry across callers
bugs.source: owner ("same-bytes recomputes are a bug") + _hashBboxKey reading raw input
bugs.note: detectAllBoundingBoxes now normalises http(s) input to bytes before the cache key, the detection and the fp stamp — one fetch, one keyspace.

bugs.title: bbox payload loadedFrom came back null even on the fixed deploy (exp #13)
bugs.source: prod exp #13: merge log line proves new code, loadedFrom still null
bugs.note: function-property state replaced with module-level slot + getter; unrecorded loads now surface as {unrecorded:true}, never null.

bugs.title: Every stored version/page had bboxDetection NULL — eval refactor orphaned detectionForVersion leg 2
bugs.source: smoke job_1787250416967_9owpz1j3b: runMetrics 18 DINO + 24 SAM calls, yet all versions+pages NULL; no code sets ev.bboxDetection anywhere any more
bugs.note: base original version now stamped directly with the Phase 5b-pre shared detection (its own bytes); scale-repair v0 deliberately unstamped (detection ran on post-repair bytes). som_identity_fallback=4 in the same run is still unexplained — the nulled detections destroyed the diag; now that detections persist, the next run carries identity.somFailure.

bugs.title: Gen-time page/cover identity builder (storyJobPipeline 4530) still used the old if(category) gate — all cover figures reached the detector undressed
bugs.source: smoke #2 job_1787252581387_6sn8z0nh2: every cover seedTrace = 'no garment colour in the identity line', seeds=0; pages seeded fine
bugs.note: converted to the shared buildIdentityClothingText/buildIdentityLine chain — the fourth and last unconverted identity-line builder.

bugs.title: refresh-bbox auto-refine stripped DINO figures bare; sequential cover saves clobbered each other
bugs.source: trial 1 on job_1787262655143_s9zb960muni: 21/21 detected, all persisted stripped; frontCover detection vanished

bugs.title: 21 DINO detection failures shipped a degraded story with zero alerting
bugs.source: story s9zb960muni runMetrics dino_detect_fail=21; nothing in failure_log/daily email

bugs.title: Garment seed dot = blob centroid, lands off-colour on non-convex blobs (neighbour hand) and mis-seeds SAM

bugs.title: Number(null)=0: unpinned Lab loads pinned themselves to v0 (never the active version) + loadedFrom always unrecorded
bugs.source: task #26 + local repro (getStoryImage called with version 0, no getActiveVersion; exps 45-50 all loadedFrom=unrecorded)
bugs.note: loadActivePageImage pinned-parse and runBboxStage loadedFrom reader now treat null/undefined/empty as "active", not v0. Root cause of the 2026-08-19 detected-on-v0 mystery.

bugs.title: refresh-bbox cover branch saved the WHOLE story doc, clobbering the preceding scene page in-flight save
bugs.source: trial-3 batch on job_1787262655143_s9zb960muni: p18 refreshed then covers; p18 detection erased (sam=0/4), single-page rerun clean
bugs.note: new saveCoverData(storyId, coverType, coverData): jsonb_set on {coverImages,<type>} only, imageVersions bytes to story_images, R2 offload + strip; refresh-bbox cover branch uses it with full-save fallback.

bugs.title: Char-repair reference = FULL 2x4 avatar sheet: extractFaceAndBody only matches the legacy tall format (aspect 1.5-2.0), square sheets (1.0) silently skip the crop
bugs.source: owner question + exp #53: Max deterministically rejected on 2 pages (bg diff 95/79, 3 internal retries ~1% apart = sheet copied); local repro: cropToFrontColumn(1024x1024 sheet) returns input bytes unchanged for ALL characters
bugs.note: char-fix (and the Lab stage) now crop the pose-matched cell via the shared resolveCellPose/cropAvatarCell chain — cropSheetCell divides by grid geometry, so SQUARE 1024x1024 sheets crop correctly (verified: front/profile/back all yield ~256x607 cells from the failing sheet). Measured: full sheet 1/5 clean, body cells 6/6 (Lab #785 vs #792/#793).
